sections.claim: Published raw TikZ-to-image example works at a RawBlock boundary and defines a fresh minimal preamble.
Compiler pipeline renders PDF then SVG for HTML.
Handler turns a raw tikzpicture block into a Pandoc Image.
raw_tex can be explicitly enabled for the LaTeX reader.
Lua filters operate between parsing and writing and run in declared order.

condition_evidence.interface: LaTeX +raw_tex→RawBlock starting with tikzpicture→official example filter compiles isolated TeX→SVG image→HTML is documented.
condition_evidence.contradictory_or_missing: The actual example.tex also needs automata/positioning/arrows libraries and a global tikzset outside tikzpicture. Published filter template has neither nor a preamble extraction mechanism. Simply returning its unmodified code does not support the whole original input. A modified template and actual raw AST boundaries remain unverified, so no complete answer is claimed.
